backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date; paper entry is next available open with production entry slippage; exit is the close ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The sleeve uses only same-day and trailing OHLCV fields plus next-open/exit prices available to replay. It does not ask LLM or production to infer hidden fields.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength

gate3.note: No new core filter or core entry rule was added. The target source is evaluated as additive default-off paper, so core survival is unchanged from the baseline replay.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry / candidate_pool: inside-day compression breakouts may surface a free-OHLCV continuation candidate source.

2_history_check.exp-20260426-057: Observed-only inside-day compression audit with forward-return statistics, but no current three-window next-open fixed-notional before/after EV replay.
2_history_check.exp-20260525-011/012: Opening-range source variants were recent; this does not use prior-day/opening-range continuation.
2_history_check.exp-20260525-020/022: Recent volatility-contraction source was tested and then QQQ confirmed; this uses a one-bar inside-day compression pattern, not ATR compression or QQQ/SPY confirmation.
2_history_check.exp-20260525-916: Sector-leadership source was rejected due window regression, drawdown drift, and concentration; this is not sector-rank based.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Same three docs/backtesting.md windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL; 3/3 EV-improved windows; no PnL-regressed window; >=20 paper trades across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration inside guardrails.

hypothesis: A production-visible inside-day compression breakout source may add candidate-pool alpha by identifying short-range contraction followed by a relative-strength close above the compression high. It expands the candidate pool without adding arbitrary noisy tickers.
interpretation: The inside-day compression top-1 paper sleeve did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote or retry nearby inside-day compression gates without a new production-visible discriminator or broader forward sample.
next_evidence_needed: If revisited, use a materially new discriminator such as source/event confirmation, market-state confirmation, or forward paper rows; do not just retune the same inside-range/relative-strength thresholds on this frozen sample.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: A retained result would still require a shared default-off paper adapter and parity tests before any daily report or live/default behavior changes.

why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking and expectation-residual because replay-safe coverage remains sparse. Skipped recent AI/compute/consumer/Space, broad-market, sector-leadership, opening-range, and volatility-contraction nearby retreads due fresh anti-repeat evidence. This uses a distinct free-OHLCV one-bar compression source.
